listing.name: Jet Force Gemini (Jet Force Gemini Recomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for Jet Force Gemini Recomp; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream claims complete fully playable campaign. No Portcove playthrough, physical controls/audio or original-multiplayer qualification here. Upstream claims full campaign v1.4, prebuilt runtime needs no developer compilation. Original multiplayer scope and this claim remain upstream evidence, not tested here. Upstream platforms: Windows x64 prebuilt runtime. ROM import requires no developer tools or player compilation. Original data: N64 JetForceGemini supported USA big-endian z64 own ROM. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
